craft-panel-element.title: Element Material Configuration
craft-panel-element.delete-confirm-info: Are you sure you want to delete this element? This will not remove element assignments already configured.
craft-panel-element.showClass-hint: Only elements matching these categories will be shown in the left elements area. Use commas to separate. If empty, all elements are shown.
craft-panel-element.requirements-hint: Only items that meet these requirements will be shown in the right materials area (you can still drag items from elsewhere into the middle configuration area).
craft-panel-element.requirements-folder-hint: Matches when the item's folder name equals one of these values (comma-separated). Highest priority.
craft-panel-element.requirements-type-hint: Matches when the item's type is included in these values (comma-separated). Lowest priority.
craft-panel-element.requirements-script-hint: Script must return a Boolean. It may reference the variable 'item' to test the item.
craft-panel-element.shape-alter-hint: If the preset shapes are not enough, configure an alternative here using the Font Awesome icon name (solid only) without the 'fa-solid fa-' prefix. For example, for use "burger-cheese".

craft-panel-recipe.title: Configure Recipe
craft-panel-recipe.edit-num-info: If only Use Min is enabled, the recipe only checks whether element amounts meet the minimum (default). If only Use Max is enabled, exceeding the max marks the recipe invalid (useful to forbid certain materials). If both are enabled the amounts must be within the range.
craft-panel-recipe.show-result-hint: If No, the recipe's crafting result won't be shown in the tooltip when hovering the recipe.
craft-panel-recipe.is-locked-hint: Locked recipes will not be displayed and cannot be crafted even if materials match.
craft-panel-recipe.craft-script-hint: Script executed when crafting. Available variables: game,data,panel,actor,recipes,elements,materials,recipe,results,canceled.
craft-panel-recipe.unlock-script-hint: Script must return a Boolean or string. false => remain locked; 'unlock' => unlocked but hidden; 'show' => unlocked and shown. Available variables: actor,recipe,panel.

craft-panel-modifier.title: Configure Modifier
craft-panel-modifier.edit-num-info: If only Use Min is enabled, the modifier only checks if element counts meet the minimum (default). If only Use Max is enabled, exceeding max marks it invalid. If both enabled, counts must be within range.
craft-panel-modifier.auto-apply-hint: If checked, the modifier will be auto-selected when conditions are met and cannot be deselected.
craft-panel-modifier.as-ae-hint: Create configured modifier as an Active Effect on the product rather than modifying the product data directly. 'Merge' merges with other merged modifiers using the product's name and icon. 'Separate' creates a separate AE with modifier name and icon.
craft-panel-modifier.ae-name-hint: Used only when creating a separate Active Effect.
craft-panel-modifier.ae-type-hint: Used only when creating a separate or merged Active Effect, specifies the type of Active Effect.
craft-panel-modifier.is-locked-hint: A locked modifier cannot be selected even if materials match.
craft-panel-modifier.unlock-script-hint: Script must return Boolean or string. false => cannot select; 'unlock' => unlocked but still needs other conditions; true => selectable regardless. Available vars: actor,modifier,panel.

craft-panel-cook-recipe.title: Select Cooking Recipe
craft-panel-cook-recipe.delete-confirm-info: Are you sure you want to delete this cooking recipe?

craft-panel-blend.title: Blend Panel
craft-panel-blend.merge-by-name-hint: If checked, the crafted result will merge with an item of the same name; otherwise a new item is always created.
craft-panel-blend.unlock-recipe-hint: If checked, the recipe is unlocked for a player to view after they craft it once. This only affects visibility, not the recipe's locked state.
craft-panel-blend.show-result-hint: Hide: never show results. Show: display results (use ? when multiple). Show Question Mark: show ? when a result exists, hide when none. By Unlock: show results after the recipe is unlocked, otherwise show ?.

craft-panel-forge.title: Forge Panel
craft-panel-forge.delete-confirm-info: Are you sure you want to delete this craft result? New results will not inherit previous edits.
craft-panel-forge.result-limit-hint: When multiple results are configured, set how many can be chosen. 0 means no limit.
craft-panel-forge.modifier-limit-hint: Maximum modifiers selectable per craft. 0 means no limit.
craft-panel-forge.base-cost-hint: Base points for selecting modifiers, even when no element values exist.
craft-panel-forge.cost-element-hint: Set the element id; available points increase by that element's amount.
craft-panel-forge.cost-script-hint: Runs initially and whenever materials are placed. Must return a number overriding available points. Vars: data,panel,actor,modifiers,elements,materials,baseCost,elementCost,cost.
craft-panel-forge.auto-quantity-hint: If checked, quantity auto-adjusts from material weight. Weight is divided by the configured value, floored, minimum 1. Not recommended for roll-table results.
craft-panel-forge.auto-weight-hint: If checked, result weight auto-adjusts from material quantity; material weight is divided by the configured result quantity. Not recommended for roll-table results or with Auto Quantity.
craft-panel-forge.origin-weight-hint: If checked, use the item's original weight for the result instead of auto or fixed weight.

craft-panel.title: Craft Panel
craft-panel.is-necessary-hint: If checked, this slot must be filled to craft.
craft-panel.is-consumed-hint: If checked, materials in this slot are consumed during crafting.
craft-panel.is-locked-hint: If locked, this slot cannot be filled.
craft-panel.unlock-script-hint: Script must return a Boolean; true unlocks this slot. Vars: data,panel,actor,elements,materials.
craft-panel.slot-script-hint: Script must return an object {isNecessary: boolean, isConsumed: boolean}. True makes the slot required/consumed; false makes it optional/not consumed. Vars: data,panel,actor,elements,materials,slotItem.
craft-panel.slot-requirements-hint: Only items meeting these requirements can be placed in the slot.
craft-panel.slot-requirements-name-hint: Meets requirement when the item name matches a configured value. Highest priority.
craft-panel.slot-requirements-type-hint: Meets requirement when the item type is included. Lowest priority.
craft-panel.slot-requirements-script-hint: Script must return a Boolean; true means requirements are met. Var: item (the tested item).
craft-panel.panel-requirements-hint: Only items meeting requirements appear in the right materials area (you can still drag from elsewhere).
craft-panel.panel-requirements-name-hint: Meets requirement when the item name matches. Highest priority.
craft-panel.panel-requirements-type-hint: Meets requirement when the item type is included. Lowest priority.
craft-panel.panel-requirements-script-hint: Script must return a Boolean; true means requirements are met. Var: item.
craft-panel.category-requirements-hint: Only items meeting requirements are shown under this category in the materials area.
craft-panel.category-requirements-name-hint: Meets requirement when the item name matches. Highest priority.
craft-panel.category-requirements-type-hint: Meets requirement when the item type is included. Lowest priority.
craft-panel.category-requirements-script-hint: Script must return a Boolean; true means requirements are met. Var: item.
craft-panel.limit-num-hint: If set, at most this many modifiers can be chosen in the category. 0 means no limit.
craft-panel.craft-script-hint: Runs after results are determined and before items are created. Vars: data,panel,actor,recipes,elements,materials,recipe,results,canceled.
craft-panel.refresh-script-hint: Runs when the UI updates (adding/removing materials). Vars: data,panel,actor,elements,materials.
craft-panel.position-unlock-hint: If checked, the slot uses absolute positioning and you can drag/configure x/y. Otherwise it uses relative layout and auto-arranges.
craft-panel.keep-materials-tooltip: Refill the same materials after crafting
craft-panel.ingredient-limit-hint: If set, materials with the same name can fill at most this many slots. 0 means no limit.
craft-panel.hide-quantity-hint: Whether to hide quantity for this slot. Default depends on material settings. Yes always hides; No always shows.
craft-panel.bind-item-hint: Set the bound item's name. The slot auto-fills items of that name and shows the total; they won't appear in the materials list. Only shows empty with quantity 0 if none are found. Ensure the name is consistent.
craft-panel.bind-item-quantity-hint: Only works when Bind Item is set and the slot is consumable. Set how many to consume during crafting. Shows total vs consume amount (e.g., 3/2). 0 consumes all.
craft-panel.bind-item-element-by-quantity-hint: Only works when Bind Item is set. Enable to add element values based on bound item quantity; use with Element per Quantity.
craft-panel.bind-item-element-per-quantity-hint: Only works when Bind Item is set. Multiplier per bound item. Example: 0.5 and consuming 4 adds 2x elements. Use with Add Element per Bound Quantity.
craft-panel.audio-volume-hint: Sound playback volume percentage, default 100, range 0-100. Foundry's volume settings also apply.
craft-panel.audio-open-panel-hint: Sound played when opening the panel.
craft-panel.audio-craft-canceled-hint: Sound played when crafting is canceled during resolution. Requires a custom script setting data.canceled = true (not in the post script). Not a failure sound.
craft-panel.ingredient-settings-multi-quantity-hint: If checked, allow multiple of the same material in one slot and show total quantity; otherwise only one per slot.
craft-panel.ingredient-settings-min-hint: If set, require at least this many of the same material. 0 means no requirement.
craft-panel.ingredient-settings-max-hint: If set, allow at most this many of the same material. 0 means no requirement.
craft-panel.ingredient-settings-element-by-quantity-: If checked, add element values based on the quantity of the same material. Use with Element per Quantity.
craft-panel.ingredient-settings-element-per-quantity: Multiplier added for each same-name material. Example: 0.5 and four materials adds 2x elements.

edit-element-config.title: Edit Element
edit-element-config.ids-hint: Shows the element ids. Use commas to configure multiple ids.
edit-element-config.name: Name
edit-element-config.name-hint: Default name shown when quantity is 0.
edit-element-config.img-hint: Default icon shown when quantity is 0.
edit-element-config.color-hint: Default color shown when quantity is 0.
edit-element-config.use-min-hint: If checked, the element amount will not go below the minimum.
edit-element-config.value-hint: Value per point used for sorting elements in the materials panel. Default 0.
edit-element-config.min-hint: Minimum value for the element. If Use Min is checked, amount won't go below this.
edit-element-config.use-max-hint: If checked, the element amount will not exceed the maximum.
edit-element-config.max-hint: Maximum value for the element. If Use Max is checked, amount won't exceed this.
edit-element-config.multi-show-hint: How to display name/icon when multiple ids are configured.
edit-element-config.multi-value-hint: How to compute value when multiple ids are configured.
edit-element-config.plus-elements-hint: Comma-separated ids that will be added to the final result if their original value is non-zero (after multi-value processing). Useful for wildcard elements.
edit-element-config.minus-elements-hint: Comma-separated ids that will be subtracted from the final result if their original value is non-zero (after multi-value processing).

notification.must-fill-necessary-slot: All necessary slots must be filled
notification.must-choose-at-least-one-result: You must choose at least one result
notification.must-fill-at-least-one-result: At least one result slot must be filled
notification.script-error: Your script has an error. Check the console (F12) for details.
notification.tableItemNotFound: Item not found in roll table

settings.quantityPath-hint: The data path for item quantity starting from 'system' (e.g. 'system.itemQuantity.value').
settings.weightPath-hint: The data path for item weight starting from 'system' (e.g. 'system.itemWeight.value'). Used for auto-quantity in cooking.
settings.descriptionPath-hint: The data path for item description starting from 'system' (e.g. 'system.text').
settings.defaultAEType-hint: The default active effect type to use when adjusting as an active effect.
settings.debug-hint: When enabled debug messages will be printed to the console.
settings.customItemColorScript-hint: Provide JS code that receives 'item' and returns a color string. Example: return item.type === 'weapon' ? '#ff0000' : '#00ff00';
